notes.title: Update 1.3: Juicy Summer!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/xZrU2qI.png

Time for Summer Vacations and we have a hot present for you. To celebrate Summer we added an Summer Level to Junipher for your joy. It will unlock after you finish Junipher 4 in the Photobook. We also did a ton of minor UI improvements and corrected many small bugs that were still present in the game! And oh, we also introduced 3 new Achievements and added 26 artworks to the The Handjob Artificer Art Pack 2 for those who own it.

During the Summer Sale all games are 20% off. We wish a hot and wet Summer for you all =)

Remember that our CUMplete Pack contains the new game, HJPS: FG2, plus The Handjob Artificer Art Pack 2, The Horny Bard Soundtrack 2 and everything from the first game, including HJPS: FG1, The Horny Bard Soundtrack, The Handjob Artificer Art Pack and The Lustful Magician Erotic Tapes. All of it with a permanent 20% discount that stacks with any sale discount!

Below is the complete changelog:

ART
We added a Summer version of Junipher. You will unlock it to play after finish Junipher 4 in the Photobook. It will also show in the Darkroom when you complete it.

PUZZLE
We have a new Level in the game! You can access it in the Juicy Holidays section. 
We changed the Unlocking Sequence for the Easter Level of Nerin. It now unlocks after finish Nerin 4 in the Photobook.
We corrected a bug that was locking some  Levels in a permanent "completed state".

PHOTOBOOK
Implemented the Juicy Summer Level in the section Juicy Holidays of the Photobook. We will add one Level for each girl in the future =)
We corrected A LOT of minor layout and UI issues in the Photobook.

QUALITY OF LIFE
You can now close any pop-up by just clicking on Esc.

ACHIEVEMENTS
We have three new Achievs now!

THE HANDJOB ARTIFICER ART PACK 2
We added the Junipher Juicy Summer artwork and 25 others artworks to the pack. It now contains 83 files!

notes.title: Update 1.1: Choose Your Fruit!
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/hCczyMl.png

The biggest news in this Update is that you can now navigate a LOT EASIER between each girl and the Fruit Girl Selection Menu in the Photobook. Besides that, we corrected a couple of bugs and improved UI elements.

Remember that our CUMplete Pack contains the new game, HJPS: FG2, and everything from the first game, including HJPS: FG1, The Horny Bard Soundtrack, The Handjob Artificer Art Pack and The Lustful Magician Erotic Tapes. All of it with a permanent 20% discount that stacks with any sale discount!

Below is the complete changelog:

PUZZLE
Now the Back button of the Puzzles correctly returns to the Photobook page of the girl that you were playing with.
The artworks of the Fruit Salad are now correctly dimensioned.
The Next button of the Fruit Salad Level 4 now redirect you to the Fruit Girl Selection Menu or the next playable Puzzle.

PHOTOBOOK
We added a simpler way for you to navigate between the different Fruit Girls. Now you can just click on the Choose Your Girl button and get back to the Fruit Girl Selection Menu.
The buttons of each girl in the Fruit Girl Selection Menu now has a highlight on them.
We standardize the layout of all the Fruit Girls texts.
All the artwork that opens each girl section now is ridden of the grayness that engulfed them.
Now each Fruit Girl section in the Photobook have decorative stickers.

STEAMWORKS
We changed the icon of the game.
The Cloud Save is supposed to be correctly working now. Let us know.
